newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - J.C. Penney cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.C. Penney cut to hold.

text.p: -- Prudential cut its rating on J.C. Penney Co Inc to hold from buy, a Prudential source said.

-- Prudential analyst Wayne Hood cut J.C. Penney's fourth quarter earnings estimate to $1.15 a share from $1.52 a share. The full year 1996 estimate was cut to $3.12 from $3.50 a share and the full year 1997 estimate was reduced to $3.60 from $3.95 a share.

-- said J.C. Penney's gross margin is currently under greater-than-expected pressure from merchandise markdowns. Expects the retailer to report net interest expenses of $95 million ($20 million above the previous estimate) for the Eckerd acquisition and from a planned $15 million share repurchase program.
